_doc: First-person arms (family: fp, ADR-0029): models/characters/fp_arms.glb names these M_fp_*. Skin and nails use the character skin shader (ADR-0028) with its screen-space subsurface blur off (the viewmodel's squeezed depth would widen it tenfold), the sleeves its cloth shader (no seam or edge data on the arms, so seams and stitching are off). Textures from tools/assetgen/textures/gen/fp.py; the arms use metre UVs, so uv_scale = 1 / tile size (m). Vertex colour: R = baked AO, G = the dirt mask (creases, knuckles, finger joints, fingertips, cuff) that reveals the fp_grime wear layer, B = the flush of blood under thin skin (knuckles, finger joints, fingertips) that fp_skin's `flush` reddens. A = the back of the hand and forearm (1) against the palm (0): `palm_pale`, `back_veins`, `knuckle_sheen` and `crease_boost` (the texture's crease net and wrinkles deepened over the knuckles and finger joints) read it. On the nails (their own face corners) B is the pink of the bed under the plate (fp_nail's `flush`; little over the lunula, none at the pale free edge) and G the grime under the free edge and in the cuticle. CUSTOM0.w (char_attrs' bruise slot; bruise stays 0) = how thin the flesh is, for `translucency` and to keep the veins off the fingers; UV2/CUSTOM0.x the rest pose. In the viewmodel the skin shader's light() (HM_VIEWMODEL) compresses a held flame's near light (`vm_light_knee`, `vm_light_compress`) and wraps the diffuse per channel (`vm_wrap`); see docs/CHARACTERS.md#first-person-arms. The game draws them with the viewmodel's own field of view (FpMaterials); the tether screen is replaced by the live tether UI once it exists.
